description: This file defines the class FormatWithTime that implements the ValueFormatter interface to format DateTime objects into a time string (H:i:s). It belongs to the namespace OrangeHRM\Maintenance\AccessStrategy\FormatValue and is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: FormatWithTime
classes.description: A class that formats DateTime objects into a time string representation.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the time formatted string ('H:i:s') if the input is a DateTime instance; otherwise, returns null.
